blocking_findings: The final desktop and mobile full-page captures show the situation-routing, care-story, and assessment content blank because .reveal elements default to opacity: 0 and the capture path does not intersect them before rendering. This violates the required below-fold and already-visible-by-default craft bars.
summary: The standardized validator passed and is bound to this build, but independent visual inspection found a blocking below-fold visibility defect. The single consolidated repair and second detector run were already consumed, so the build is truthfully failed and requires a bounded correction task before promotion.
